purpose: Turn demonstrated AI/project-operation failures into repeatable capability and regression evals without pretending deterministic CI can judge open-ended semantics by itself.

deterministic: expected tokens are present in the configured result fields
forbidden tokens are absent from the configured result fields
the case result does not claim stronger assurance than the fixture permits
judgement: whether the selected action is materially appropriate when multiple valid actions exist
whether impact discovery found all semantically relevant objects
whether natural-language rationale preserves domain meaning
grading.rule: Deterministic grading may fail a run for explicit invariant violation. Passing deterministic grading is not proof of domain truth, complete impact discovery or owner acceptance.

promotion.capability_case: A new demonstrated failure or difficult historical replay may begin as a capability eval.
promotion.regression_case: After a control/fix is accepted, retain the historical failure as a regression case.
